description: Create house.electronics: everything with a plug or a battery.
rationale: Serial number and warranty date are what an insurance claim asks for, and no other category has them. model is varchar(60) on purpose -- 0098 widens it, which is how the dependent-view rebuild gets exercised on a real view.

intents.comment: Detail for an item of category electronics. One row per house.item row.

columns.name: model
columns.comment: Manufacturer's model designation. Required: it is the only way to find a manual.

columns.name: serial_number
columns.comment: Serial number, where it is still legible. Unique across the house when present.

columns.name: power_watts
columns.comment: Rated power draw in watts. Null where the label is gone.

columns.name: warranty_until
columns.comment: Last day the warranty covers. Null when there was none or nobody kept the receipt.

intents.name: electronics_kind_idx
intents.comment: All the monitors, all the appliances.

intents.name: electronics_warranty_until_idx
intents.comment: Partial: only rows with a warranty are ever asked 'what expires next', and most rows have none.
